name: Pull-Up

instructions.description: Hang from a pull-up bar with hands slightly wider than shoulder width and shoulders active.
Brace your trunk and initiate the movement by drawing the shoulder blades down and back.
Pull your body upward until your chin clears the bar or as high as you can with control.
Lower yourself slowly to a full hang without dropping suddenly.

performanceMetrics.notes: Use controlled full-range repetitions when possible.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Use an assistance band to reduce bodyweight load.

commentsNotes: Avoid craning the neck to reach the bar.
Do not swing excessively unless intentionally training a different skill.
